checks.source: Pickett CW, Lees RE (1991). A cross-sectional study of health complaints among 79 data entry operators using video display terminals. The Journal of the Society of Occupational Medicine.

source_fit_rows.source_population: 79 adult office data-entry clerks using video display terminals across five offices in Ontario, Canada reporting work-related eyestrain and headache
source_fit_rows.family_population: 34-year-old office worker with 2 hours of eyestrain and a mild dull forehead ache from reading tiny spreadsheet numbers at an office desk
source_fit_rows.note: Same adult office computer / data-entry worker population reporting occupational 'eyestrain' (used verbatim) alongside headache.
